counts-original.query: select count(b.id),sum(case when b.status='pending' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='cancelled' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='completed' then 1 else 0 end) from bookings b where (md5('partner')::uuid is null or exists(select d.id from booking_details d,accommodation_snapshot s,accommodations a where d.booking_id=b.id and d.accommodation_snapshot_id=s.id and s.accommodation_id=a.id and a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid))

revenue-original.query: select coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) from payments p where p.status='success' and (md5('partner')::uuid is null or exists(select b.id from bookings b where b.id=p.booking_id and exists(select d.id from booking_details d,accommodation_snapshot s,accommodations a where d.booking_id=b.id and d.accommodation_snapshot_id=s.id and s.accommodation_id=a.id and a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)))

counts-in.query: select count(b.id),sum(case when b.status='pending' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='cancelled' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='completed' then 1 else 0 end) from bookings b where b.id in (select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)

revenue-in.query: select coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) from payments p where p.status='success' and p.booking_id in (select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)
